meaning: Independent finite native Policy semantic controls over explicit structural inputs and declared Rule references; selection returns a strategy identity without executing it.
oracle: Interpret checked input types, Rule closures and Policy argument expressions independently of generators. Validate all inputs, evaluate cases in source order until the first true Rule, otherwise select the exact default. Preserve repeated case/Rule/target occurrences, exact UInt64, raw String, identity versus value equality, optional fields, sums and ordered/unordered collections.
cases: Reuse source-derived structural facts and malformed inputs without factory ownership or invariant filtering. Include source literals from Policy arguments and transitive Rule references. Compare exact selector strings or TypeError POLICY_INPUT, with zero getters/coercion calls and no caller-input mutation. Require at least two distinct source-predicted valid result targets as bounded input-sensitivity witnesses. Missing witnesses leave the whole Policy not_evaluable, not a source rejection or unreachable-branch proof.
bounds: Preserve 4096 expanded facts/cases per node, 65536 project cases and 8 MiB serialized controls, with independent expression visits capped at 65536/depth 64 per Policy evaluation. Deduplicated recipe transport changes neither fresh runtime values nor case coverage. Capacity or witness exhaustion retains every source node and keeps the entire Policy unmet.
execution: Observe actual generated Policy and declared Rule modules through the existing private permission-restricted native runner. Exact dependency closure excludes strategy targets and factory providers. A native result is a selector string, never a Boolean, executable object or target result. Cross-generator and full composition controls remain separate.
compatibility: Preserve all 48 source predecessors, existing Rule/Policy/factory meanings, source order, profile boundaries and legacy defaults. No SFOL, AlchLang, strategy execution, production provider, publication, admission or installation effects.
